data.one_liner: A library to communicate with a service implementing the Dart VM service protocol.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart client library to communicate with the Dart VM service protocol. It allows developers to interact with running Dart and Flutter virtual machines for debugging and inspection purposes.
use_when: Building debugging tools or developer extensions for Dart and Flutter
Interacting directly with the Dart VM service protocol programmatically
avoid_when: Building standard application features unrelated to debugging or VM inspection
strengths: Official library for communicating with the Dart VM service
Kept up-to-date with Dart VM service protocol specifications
weaknesses: Low-level protocol client which requires deep understanding of the Dart VM service spec
